source_file: %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenAI\Codex\bin\8e5b6932251c2c1c\codex.exe (the engine the MSIX ChatGPT app and the npm CLI both unpack; byte-identical codex-cli 0.153.4)
note: A rule, not a schema. Codex publishes no machine-readable schema for config.toml, so every entry here is a string read out of the shipped binary's own serde tables and error text, with the live runs that reproduced the behaviour recorded in versions.txt.
provider_fields_evidence: the serde field list emitted next to the literal 'ModelProviderInfo' in the binary's string table: 'namebase_urlenv_keyenv_key_instructionsexperimental_bearer_tokenauthwire_apiquery_paramshttp_headersenv_http_headersrequest_max_retriesstream_max_retriesstream_idle_timeout_mswebsocket_connect_timeout_msrequires_openai_authsupports_websocketssupports_standalone_web_searchModelProviderInfo'
unknown_keys_evidence: no deny_unknown_fields on the root config or on ModelProviderInfo; a bogus root key and a bogus provider field both left `codex doctor` reporting 'config loaded'. Retired *known* keys are the exception, which is what wire_api = "chat" is.
wire_api_evidence: two strings, six occurrences: '`wire_api = "chat"` is no longer supported.' and 'set `wire_api = "responses"` in your provider config.' Reproduced live under a scratch CODEX_HOME: `codex exec --skip-git-repo-check "say hi"` answered 'Error loading config.toml: ...' and exited 1. This is a config-load failure, so it takes every unrelated setting in the file down with it, in the CLI and in the desktop app.
base_url_evidence: Codex appends '/responses' to base_url; the bundled responses-api-proxy default is 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses'.

credential.evidence: 'Missing environment variable: `' is a hard error with no fallback to the ChatGPT OAuth in auth.json; `codex doctor` renders it as 'auth   active model provider auth env var is missing'. experimental_bearer_token takes the literal and proceeds to the network -- the field CLIProxyAPI's own Codex-App recipe uses for exactly this reason.

not_extracted: What the desktop GUI does after a valid config loads. openai/codex#29156 reports the model picker degrading with any custom provider; the app was never launched here, so that is on the card as a report and is not asserted.
